value.body:
The Hub addresses the need for a transdisciplinary understanding of governance challenges and opportunities across such technologies. Research focus is centred on digital ethics and rights frameworks that assist in identifying and mitigating the gaps between rapid technological disruption and diffusion.

Core research areas include

  • Data, economy and society;
  • Artificial intelligence;
  • Outer space;
  • Digitalization, security and democracy; and the environment and natural resources.

Approach

The Hub is founded on a transdisciplinary approach (i.e., research that cuts across disciplines and connects fellows with policy makers and industry professionals) that seeks to increase our collective understanding of the socio-economic and technological impacts of digitalization.

value.intro_text:
The CIGI Auditorium is a world-class venue in the heart of Waterloo, available for rental to non-profit organizations, community groups and businesses. Amenities include:

  • High-definition projector
  • Continuous ceiling projection
  • Four HD cameras
  • Podium with microphone
  • Integrated listening-assist technology
  • Broadcasting and recording

value.heading: CIGI Main Foyer
value.intro_text: The CIGI Main Foyer gives different gatherings a distinct setting to listen to the surrounding glass corridors, modern architecture and CIGI sensibilities. The venue features natural stone flooring and can seat up to 200 guests for a reception or dinner event.
